title: VTG 1996 Topps The X-Files Season 2 Card #49 Production for Irresistible
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1996 Topps The X-Files Season 2 Card #49 featuring the characters Mulder and Scully from the popular TV show. This non-sport trading card is part of the original set and is made of card stock with a glossy finish. The card is a 1st print run and is in English, making it a sought-after collectible for fans of The X-Files franchise. It is a standard-sized card with a 20 Pt. thickness, perfect for collectors who appreciate vintage items from the show.
